topic_name_en: Topic 2: Demand Theory and Law of Demand (Qd, Determinants)
question_uz: Talab qonuni (Law of Demand) nimani ifodalaydi?
question_en: What does the Law of Demand state?
options_uz: Tovar narxi oshsa, xaridorlar uni ko'proq sotib oladilar
Narx bilan talab miqdori o'rtasida to'g'ri mutanosiblik mavjud
Boshqa omillar o'zgarmas bo'lganda (ceteris paribus), tovar narxi oshsa unga bo'lgan talab miqdori (Qd) kamayadi, narx pasaysa talab miqdori oshadi
Talab miqdori narxga mutlaqo bog'liq emas
options_en: As price rises, people buy more
Direct positive relationship between price and Qd
Ceteris paribus, as price increases, quantity demanded decreases; as price falls, Qd increases
Quantity demanded is independent of price
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Narx va xarid qilinadigan miqdor o'rtasidagi teskari bog'liqlik (kamayib boruvchi egri chiziq).
why_right: To'g'ri javob: «Boshqa omillar o'zgarmas bo'lganda (ceteris paribus), tovar narxi oshsa unga bo'lgan talab miqdori (Qd) kamayadi, narx pasaysa talab miqdori oshadi». Talab qonuniga ko'ra narx (P) va talab hajmi (Qd) o'rtasida teskari bog'liqlik mavjud. Narx ko'tarilishi xaridorni muqobil arzonroq tovarlarga o'tishga (almashtirish effekti) va xarid qobiliyatini pasayishiga (daromad effekti) majbur qiladi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Ceteris paribus, as price increases, quantity demanded decreases; as price falls, Qd increases».

question_uz: Talab hajmining o'zgarishi (Change in Quantity Demanded) bilan Talabning o'zgarishi (Change in Demand) o'rtasidagi farq nimada?
question_en: What is the difference between a change in Quantity Demanded and a change in Demand?
options_uz: Talab hajmi o'zgarganda butun egri chiziq yo'qoladi
Talab hajmi FAQAT ushbu tovarning o'z narxi o'zgarganda egri chiziq bo'ylab harakatlanadi; Talab esa narxdan tashqari omillar ta'sirida butun egri chiziqning o'ngga yoki chapga siljishidir
options_en: Quantity demanded changes only along the curve due to own price; Demand shifts the entire curve due to non-price determinants
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Egri chiziq bo'ylab harakat (faqat P o'zgarganda) vs butun chiziqning ko'chishi (daromad, moda, reklama o'zgarganda).

Boshqa omillar o'zgarmas bo'lganda (ceteris paribus), tovar narxi oshsa sotuvga chiqariladigan taklif miqdori (Qs) ortadi, narx pasaysa taklif miqdori kamayadi

question_uz: Kamayib boruvchi chekli unumdorlik qonuni (Law of Diminishing Marginal Returns) nimani ifodalaydi?
question_en: What does the Law of Diminishing Marginal Returns state?
options_uz: Ishchilar ko'paysa mahsulot har doim cheksiz oshaveradi

Doimiy omil (masalan, 1 ta dastgoh) mavjud bo'lganda, unga o'zgaruvchan omil (ishchilar) muttasil qo'shib borilsa, ma'lum nuqtadan so'ng har bir yangi ishchining qo'shgan chekli mahsuloti (MP) kamayib boradi
options_en: Adding more of a variable input to fixed inputs eventually leads to declining marginal product (MP)
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Bitta kichik oshxonaga 10 ta oshpazni tiqib qo'ysangiz, ular bir-biriga xalal berib, unumdorlik pasayadi.
why_right: To'g'ri javob: «Doimiy omil (masalan, 1 ta dastgoh) mavjud bo'lganda, unga o'zgaruvchan omil (ishchilar) muttasil qo'shib borilsa, ma'lum nuqtadan so'ng har bir yangi ishchining qo'shgan chekli mahsuloti (MP) kamayib boradi». question_uz: Gerfindal-Xirshman indeksi (HHI - Herfindahl-Hirschman Index) nima uchun ishlatiladi?
question_en: What does the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) measure?
options_uz: Bozordagi konsentratsiya (monopollashuv) darajasini aniqlash uchun barcha firmalarning bozor ulushlari kvadratlari yig'indisini hisoblaydi (HHI = Σ si²)
options_en: Measures market concentration by summing the squares of market shares of all firms (HHI = sum si²)
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Bozor 1 kishi qo'lidami yoki ko'pchilik o'rtasidami? HHI 10 000 ga yaqinlashsa — toza monopoliya.
why_right: To'g'ri javob: «Bozordagi konsentratsiya (monopollashuv) darajasini aniqlash uchun barcha firmalarning bozor ulushlari kvadratlari yig'indisini hisoblaydi (HHI = Σ si²)». HHI indeksi antimonopol organlar tomonidan qo'llaniladi. Agar HHI 1 500 dan past bo'lsa — past konsentratsiyali raqobatli bozor; 2 500 dan yuqori bo'lsa — yuqori darajada monopollashgan bozor hisoblanadi.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Measures market concentration by summing the squares of market shares of all firms (HHI = sum si²)».
